description: BrandPilot Ground-Truth Labelled Evaluation Dataset for Editorial Brand Governance Review

guidelines_reference.text: Use clear, friendly language that a non-expert can understand.
Avoid hype, superlatives and guarantees (e.g. 'best', 'revolutionary', 'guaranteed') unless backed by an approved fact.
Speak directly to the reader using 'you' and prefer active voice.

approved_facts.text: The service is available in 10 regions
Customer support is available 24 hours a day via chat
